instruction: Cinematic full shot of a ballet performance on an indoor stage with a dark green festive backdrop. On the left, the male dancer in a red jacket and white tights (R1) stands facing right, holding his partner's hand high. On the right, the female dancer in a pink tutu (R2) stands on pointe, facing forward-left. Soft stage lighting illuminates the couple, creating a warm focus against the cool background.
